verdict.rationale: LiveKit's docs present server-side voice agents as a core product: Python/Node.js voice agents with automatic turn detection and interruption handling, deployed to LiveKit Cloud, with callers bridged into rooms. Together these show an agent that takes in live audio and speaks back in realtime within a session. missing for 10: an explicit statement that the agent joins the room as a participant and subscribes to and publishes audio tracks, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of realtime agent performance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a server-side agent joins a session as a participant that receives live audio and publishes speech back in realtime

citations.quote: Build a simple voice agent with Python or Node.js in less than 10 minutes.
Automatic turn detection and interruption handling
Deploy and run agents directly on LiveKit Cloud without managing servers or orchestration.
connect PSTN calls directly into LiveKit rooms without setting up trunks
Execute custom methods on other participants and await a response.
